system.description:
You settle into a quiet pocket of cover and let searching eyes slide past.

Opposed by INT. Remain stationary out of sight, with Advantage behind larger cover. Hidden until leaving cover or affecting another creature; area attacks can still hit.

upgrades.rank5: May hide in dim light without cover.
upgrades.rank10: Other party crawlers using this skill untrained no longer suffer Disadvantage.
upgrades.rank15: May hide in a lightly shaded area and take a Step without revealing your position.
